protocol.clearance: Minimum rectangle-to-Barrier sample-chord distance minus 0.12 m half-thickness, at every retained 120 Hz frame. Sampled clearance is not continuous swept-contact validation; the player solver separately checks every step against its physical wall chords.
protocol.steering: Absolute finite-difference front-wheel steering rate at 120 Hz: p95 and maximum; total absolute angle variation over the measured lap penalizes repeated corrections.
protocol.thresholdRationale: Preserve the demonstrated iteration-3 clearance and steering behavior, allowing only 1 cm clearance rounding, 0.01 rad/s rate rounding, and 0.1 rad total-variation rounding. These conservative baseline-relative limits are fixed before main search, not relaxed to admit faster results.
protocol.stopRule: One complete fixed grid: at most 72 controller settings on each of two preserved geometries, or earlier explicit budget. No adaptive expansion.
protocol.execution: Two warmup laps then one measured lap; existing swept whole-Kart contact and closure rejection. Player physics unchanged; only declared reference-driver settings vary.
